overview.en: The Myth of Sisyphus explores Albert Camus’ absurdism through a multi-platform alternate reality game. A physical poster leads players into a simulated university, where automated emails, coding assignments, and a fictional school website form an unfolding narrative. Web systems, Python puzzles, and an AI chatbot turn familiar digital infrastructure into an experience about searching for meaning within an indifferent system.
overview.zh: 《西西弗神话》通过跨平台的另类实境游戏，探索阿尔贝·加缪的荒诞主义。玩家从一张实体海报出发，进入由自动邮件、编程作业与虚构学校网站组成的大学环境。网页系统、Python 谜题和 AI 聊天机器人将熟悉的数字设施变成叙事的一部分，让玩家体验在一个漠然的系统中寻找意义的过程。

design_question.en: Can a digital system simulate the experience of absurdity?
design_question.zh: 数字系统能否让人亲身感受到荒诞？

text.en: Project poster, digital collage and drawing
text.zh: 项目海报，数字拼贴与绘画

paragraphs.en: I created a poster for a fictional academic institution as the game’s entry point. Sending an email to its contact address triggers an automated reply. The aim is to establish a believable academic setting so that players initially approach the experience as a real programming challenge.
paragraphs.zh: 我为一个虚构的学术机构制作海报，作为游戏的入口。玩家向海报上的联系地址发送邮件后，会收到自动回复。我希望先建立一个可信的学术环境，让玩家起初把这段体验当作真实的编程挑战。

paragraphs.en: In the reply, a professor explains that he is out of town and leaves the player a programming assignment. Its tone and format closely resemble a real professor’s email.
paragraphs.zh: 回复邮件中的教授解释自己暂时不在学校，并给玩家留下一份编程作业。邮件的语气与格式都尽量贴近真实的教授来信。

paragraphs.en: The assignment is a Python file asking the player to fix a bug in a simple weighted-average function. It initially looks like an ordinary beginner exercise, but the autograder compares random floating-point values with the function’s output, making the test impossible to pass.
paragraphs.zh: 作业是一份 Python 文件，要求玩家修复一个简单加权平均函数中的错误。它看起来像普通的入门练习，但自动评分程序会将随机浮点数与函数输出进行比较，使测试始终无法通过。

paragraphs.en: This mechanic echoes Sisyphus: however hard the player tries, the stone rolls back to the beginning. Progress requires recognizing that the system itself is flawed. A clue hidden in the autograder’s comments points toward the next puzzle, outside the usual programming workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 这一机制呼应了西西弗的处境：无论玩家多么努力，石头都会滚回起点。玩家需要意识到，问题出在系统本身。自动评分程序注释中的线索指向下一道谜题，也暗示答案在常规编程流程之外。

caption.zh: Leet Code Academy 招生海报
虚构教师的邮件
Jupyter Notebook 中的编程作业
隐藏的荒诞测试代码

paragraphs.en: The final stage takes place on a fictional school website. Its student portal hides the ending, which players reach by gathering clues to the correct username and password. I designed the interface to resemble an outdated university portal, bringing the earlier email and programming clues together in a believable academic environment.
paragraphs.zh: 游戏的最后阶段发生在虚构的学校网站上。结局藏在学生门户后，玩家需要收集线索，找到正确的用户名与密码才能进入。我将界面设计成老旧大学网站的样子，把邮件与编程作业中的线索汇集到一个可信的学术环境中。

paragraphs.en: An AI assistant in the bottom-right corner serves as both a hint system and a philosophical conversation partner. It asks questions such as “How do you define meaning in your daily experiences?” If players repeatedly request the login credentials, it eventually reveals them.
paragraphs.zh: 页面右下角的 AI 助手既提供提示，也与玩家进行哲学对话，例如询问：“你如何定义日常经历中的意义？”如果玩家反复追问登录信息，它最终会给出答案。

paragraphs.en: Puzzles are spread across the site. CSE 1A, the class mentioned in the email, is absent from the course catalog. Searching for it returns “no class found,” with the letter “n” in bold. Bold letters scattered across other pages form “meaning.” Its ASCII conversion becomes the password; the username, “lukewam,” is hidden in the website URL.
paragraphs.zh: 谜题分散在整个网站中。邮件提到的 CSE 1A 并不存在于课程目录里，搜索后会出现“no class found”，其中字母“n”被加粗。其他页面上零散的粗体字母最终组成“meaning”。将这个词转换为 ASCII 编码即可得到密码；用户名“lukewam”则藏在网站地址中。

paragraphs.en: The fragmented clues and bureaucratic structure extend the project’s central question: how do we search for meaning in systems that may never offer a clear answer?
paragraphs.zh: 碎片化的线索和官僚式的网站结构延续了作品的核心问题：当一个系统可能永远不会给出明确答案时，我们如何在其中寻找意义？

text.en: The website acts as the central hub of the ARG, where earlier clues from emails and assignments converge into a final puzzle.
text.zh: 网站是游戏的中心，邮件与作业中的线索在这里汇集成最后的谜题。

caption.en: Leet Code Academy homepage and helper chatbot
caption.zh: Leet Code Academy 首页与聊天助手
虚构学校的课程目录
荒诞主义导论课程页面

paragraphs.en: After entering the student portal, players meet an AI chatbot named John Smith, the fictional instructor behind the earlier email. It begins a conversation about absurdity and the search for meaning rather than supplying a final answer.
paragraphs.zh: 进入学生门户后，玩家会遇见名为 John Smith 的 AI 聊天机器人，也就是此前发送邮件的虚构教师。他没有给出最终答案，而是与玩家谈论荒诞和对意义的寻找。

paragraphs.en: The experience shifts from solving puzzles to reflection. Emails, programming assignments, and academic portals appear logical, yet gradually fail to provide a clear resolution. The chatbot suggests that this lack of closure is intentional. Inspired by Camus, the work explores the tension between our desire for clear answers and the ambiguity of lived experience. It ends by inviting players to interpret what happened for themselves.
paragraphs.zh: 体验由解谜转向反思。邮件、编程作业与学术门户看似遵循逻辑，却始终无法带来明确的结论。聊天机器人提出，这种无法收束的状态正是设计的一部分。受到加缪的启发，作品探索人对明确答案的渴望与现实经验中的含混之间的张力，并邀请玩家自行理解这段经历。

subtitle.en: A mobile game prototype for climate action
subtitle.zh: 鼓励气候行动的手机游戏原型

role.zh: 原型与界面开发负责人

overview.en: My Beloved Polar Bear is a Tamagotchi-inspired mobile game prototype designed to encourage Gen Z players to take climate action. Completing real-world eco-friendly tasks earns coins to feed and customize a virtual polar bear. Players can also share progress and connect with others. The concept brings care, personalization, and community into everyday sustainable actions.
overview.zh: 《我心爱的北极熊》是一款受到 Tamagotchi 电子宠物启发的手机游戏原型，旨在鼓励 Z 世代玩家参与气候行动。玩家通过完成现实中的环保任务获得金币，用来喂养和装扮虚拟北极熊，也可以分享进度、与其他玩家互动。这个概念将照料、个性化与社交融入日常的可持续行动。

paragraphs.en: We surveyed more than 100 participants through Google Forms, primarily Gen Z students. Most were already taking small climate-friendly actions but needed more encouragement to act consistently. Many found educational games unappealing or boring, which led us toward familiar mobile-game formats.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过 Google Forms 调研了 100 多名参与者，主要面向 Z 世代学生。多数人已经在日常生活中采取一些环保行动，但仍需要更多动力来持续行动。许多人认为教育游戏缺乏吸引力或显得无聊，因此我们转向更接近流行手机游戏的形式。

paragraphs.en: We explored three concepts: clean-energy racing, an RPG in which collecting trash earns levels, and a digital pet fed through completing tasks. We chose My Beloved Polar Bear because its incentives were easy to understand and the concept was feasible as a small-scale game.
paragraphs.zh: 我们探索了三个概念：清洁能源赛车游戏、通过捡拾垃圾升级的 RPG，以及通过完成任务来喂养的电子宠物。最终选择《我心爱的北极熊》，因为它的激励方式容易理解，也适合做成规模较小的游戏。

paragraphs.en: Using Figma, we mapped the key interactions and tested two screen variations, A and B, for customization, task progress, and task history. I designed Flow B.

paragraphs.en: Testing combined demographic questions, tasks, and follow-up questions. We recorded completion time, participants’ self-ratings, and qualitative feedback. The results indicated that version B was more intuitive, informing the next design iteration.
paragraphs.zh: 测试包括背景问题、操作任务与追问，并记录任务完成时间、参与者自评和定性反馈。结果显示 B 版更直观，为后续设计迭代提供了方向。

paragraphs.en: I designed the customization and feeding systems, including inventories, icons, items, and tasks. The prototype also includes a food shop, social page, and user profile.

overview.en: Disaster Defender is a Meta Quest 2 VR game designed to let players practice responding to emergencies in a simulated urban disaster scene. Players find injured people, assess their injuries, spawn first-aid items, and follow guided steps within a time limit.
overview.zh: 《灾难守护者》是一款面向 Meta Quest 2 的 VR 游戏，让玩家在模拟的城市灾后环境中练习应急响应。玩家需要寻找伤者、判断伤情、生成所需的急救物品，并在限定时间内依照指引完成救援步骤。

paragraphs.en: We initially built the game in Unity and C# around controller input. I created a sample medical room and developed selection, manipulation, and movement. A ray from the controller lets players select and manipulate items with buttons; aiming at the ground and pressing another button enables teleportation.
paragraphs.zh: 游戏最初使用 Unity 和 C# 开发，通过手柄交互。我搭建了用于原型测试的医疗室，并开发了选择、操作与移动功能。玩家通过手柄射线和按键选择、操作物品，也可以将射线指向地面并按下另一按键进行传送。

paragraphs.en: An arrow guides players toward injured people. A button opens a menu, where the controller ray supports text selection and choosing items to spawn. The prototype also supports text input.
paragraphs.zh: 方向箭头引导玩家找到伤者。按键可以打开菜单，玩家通过手柄射线选择文字与需要生成的物品，原型也支持文本输入。

paragraphs.en: During testing, I attached the menu to the player model so it would follow the player, adjusted its height dynamically, and hid it when not in use.
paragraphs.zh: 测试时，我将菜单绑定到玩家模型，让它随玩家移动，同时动态调整高度，并在不用时隐藏。

paragraphs.en: We implemented hand tracking with the Meta Interaction SDK in Unity, defining gestures the headset could detect and connecting them to the prototype’s button interactions. This made it possible to interact without handheld controllers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Unity 中的 Meta Interaction SDK 实现手部追踪，定义头显能够识别的手势，并将它们对应到原型中的按键交互，使玩家能够脱离手持控制器进行操作。

paragraphs.en: Some gestures were difficult to recognize reliably. I was responsible for designing simple, distinct, and intuitive gestures to improve tracking reliability and the flow of play.
paragraphs.zh: 部分手势难以稳定识别。我负责设计简单、彼此区分清晰且容易理解的手势，以改善识别的可靠性与游戏操作体验。

subtitle.en: An autonomous vehicle with object detection
subtitle.zh: 具备目标识别能力的自动驾驶小车

role.en: Hardware design and tracking software development lead
role.zh: 硬件设计与循迹软件开发负责人

overview.en: An AI-driven autonomous vehicle built with NVIDIA onboard hardware, designed to follow track lines and respond to stop, park, accelerate, and decelerate signs. A top-mounted camera observes the road, while front-mounted radar provides depth sensing. A remote laptop connection also allows manual control.
overview.zh: 这辆基于 NVIDIA 车载硬件的 AI 自动驾驶小车能够沿赛道行驶，并响应停止、停车、加速和减速标志。顶部摄像头观察路面，前置雷达用于深度感知。小车也可以远程连接笔记本电脑，进行手动控制。

paragraphs.en: I constructed and wired the car, using LightBurn to design the main board and Blender to model a protective case for 3D printing. The assembly combines a laser-cut acrylic board, a 3D-printed case for the NVIDIA computer and camera, and a centrally placed VESC motor controller.
paragraphs.zh: 我负责小车的组装与接线，使用 LightBurn 设计主板结构，用 Blender 制作保护外壳的模型并进行 3D 打印。车身采用激光切割的亚克力板，NVIDIA 计算硬件与摄像头装在 3D 打印外壳中，VESC 电机控制器位于中央。

paragraphs.en: A remote connection to a laptop supports live video streaming and manual control through the arrow keys.
paragraphs.zh: 通过远程连接笔记本电脑，可以查看实时视频，并用方向键手动驾驶。

text.en: Remotely connected to a laptop for video streaming and arrow key control

text.en: Work in progress: laser-cut custom acrylic board, 3D-printed case for the NVIDIA CPU and camera, with a VESC motor control chip centrally placed.
text.zh: 制作过程：激光切割的定制亚克力板、用于 NVIDIA 计算硬件和摄像头的 3D 打印外壳，以及中央的 VESC 电机控制器。

paragraphs.en: I manually drove the vehicle under different lighting conditions and collected driving data from 30 laps. I trained an AI model on a remote server, then uploaded it to the NVIDIA hardware so the car could imitate the manual driving patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 我在不同光照条件下手动驾驶小车，收集了 30 圈的驾驶数据。随后在远程服务器上训练 AI 模型，并将其上传到 NVIDIA 硬件，让小车学习手动驾驶的模式。

paragraphs.en: Reflections on the track caused poor performance, so I repeated the training process several times while working to improve the result.
paragraphs.zh: 赛道反光影响了识别与驾驶表现，因此我多次重复训练，尝试改善效果。

caption.en: Driving data and demonstration video on desktop

paragraphs.en: We reworked the algorithm in OpenCV so the car could recognize and react to colors rather than only imitate the driver. I wrote the color detection: white identified track edges, red meant stop, black represented the track, and light blue marked out-of-bounds areas.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 OpenCV 调整算法，让小车识别颜色并作出响应，而不只是模仿驾驶者。我负责编写颜色检测：白色代表赛道边缘，红色代表停止，黑色代表赛道，浅蓝色代表越界区域。

paragraphs.en: This gave us more flexibility to program the vehicle’s responses, including its reactions to road signs.
paragraphs.zh: 这让我们能够更灵活地设置小车的行为，包括对路标的响应。

subtitle.en: An Android app for the San Diego Zoo
subtitle.zh: 圣地亚哥动物园 Android 导航应用

overview.en: Zoo Navigator is an Android app for planning a visit to the San Diego Zoo. Visitors can search for animals using partial words, add places they want to see, and calculate a route through their selected stops. The app offers detailed navigation and a simpler guide mode.
overview.zh: Zoo Navigator 是一款帮助游客规划圣地亚哥动物园行程的 Android 应用。游客可以输入部分名称搜索动物，添加想去的地点，并计算串联这些地点的路线。应用同时提供详细导航和简洁导览模式。

paragraphs.en: I was responsible for the navigation and search systems. I used Dijkstra’s algorithm to calculate shortest paths, treating each road as an edge with a specific distance. Beginning at the visitor’s location, the algorithm calculates and updates paths to the selected destinations.
paragraphs.zh: 我负责导航与搜索系统，使用 Dijkstra 算法计算最短路径，将每条道路视为带有距离权重的边。算法从游客当前位置出发，计算并更新前往所选目的地的路径。

paragraphs.en: We manually imported the San Diego Zoo map data and developed the app in Android Studio. Its modular structure separates each function into its own files. I conducted unit tests for individual features and integration tests that simulated the overall user experience.
paragraphs.zh: 我们手动导入圣地亚哥动物园的地图数据，并在 Android Studio 中开发应用。程序采用模块化结构，将不同功能拆分到独立文件中。我负责对各项功能进行单元测试，并通过集成测试模拟完整的使用流程。
